plan.title: Closed RFQ withdrawal cancel leaves event unchanged

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ instead of creating or searching for an event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Open the RFQ stage whose withdrawal controls are being tested.
Open Responses as specified by the case.
Record that the existing bidder is still shown before attempting withdrawal.
Record that the existing bid price is shown before attempting withdrawal.
Open the RFQ stage's Withdraw action and leave the withdrawal window open.
Assert that the withdrawal window opened.
Cancel the withdrawal rather than confirming it.
Assert that cancelling closes the withdrawal window.
Verify the bidder remains unchanged after cancellation.
Verify the existing bid remains unchanged after cancellation.
Confirm the event screen remains rendered without an error or withdrawal-related change.
